caption: Funnel lane-hugging around terrain, recorded on the optimized build. This clip exercises the funnel corner-arrive test in _funnel_corner -- one of the two PathField comparisons this PR squares -- and, via its scripted clicks, SelectionManager._unit_at's squared body pick. The route and the selections are unchanged: both comparisons square their threshold too, which is exactly equivalent for non-negative operands. The other PathField edit, in next_step_fleeing, is not reachable here (a drill scenario with no enemies has no routing unit) and is covered by test_next_step_fleeing_* instead.
